name: PERIGEE
tagline: An EP conducted by a coding agent
blurb: Five-track EP conducted on an Analog Rytm MKII by a coding agent, composed with its human. Listen, download, and read how each track was built.

name: LEMON AUDIO
blurb: A minimal home for audio hardware work. Hosts a browser-based (WebUSB) firmware flasher for Daisy-platform Eurorack modules, so firmware like qpas-ish and duopulse can be flashed without a toolchain.

name: LEMON DROPS
blurb: Small browser music apps, released weekly, one genre at a time. Nothing to install and nothing to configure.

name: Hot Techno Loops
blurb: Techno drum loops generated in the browser from pure synthesis. No samples anywhere, and the result exports to WAV.

name: Analog Rytm agent bridge
tagline: A control plane for a drum machine
blurb: Lets a coding agent operate an Elektron Analog Rytm MKII: validated deltas, raw SysEx snapshots, readback verification, and byte-exact rollback.

name: duopulse
blurb: Eurorack firmware for the Patch.Init. An opinionated 2-voice percussion sequencer for techno through experimental IDM. Zero shift layers; every parameter is directly accessible across eight knobs and two modes.

name: qpas-ish
blurb: Rust firmware for the Electrosmith Daisy Patch SM. A QPAS-inspired clocked stereo resonant filter with two state-variable cores, continuous LP/BP/HP morph and stereo frequency spread, built for resonant pinging.

name: smpl
tagline: Audio analysis you pipe like jq
blurb: A composable, content-addressed audio-analysis toolchain. NDJSON frames over a content store, canonical-PCM hashing, and free pipeline memoization. Built so agents and humans drive it the same way.

name: rytm-rs
tagline: Rust SDK for the Analog Rytm
blurb: Safe Rust abstractions over rytm-sys, an unofficial SDK for writing software that talks to an Analog Rytm running firmware 1.70.

name: Sample Curator
blurb: A desktop app for keeping a sample library in order. Tauri and Rust underneath, with downloadable builds on the releases page.

name: hatch3d
blurb: Generative compositions and a hatching algorithm targeting the AxiDraw. Daily ingest from /r/plotterart for inspiration; a print queue runs on a Raspberry Pi.

name: Breach
tagline: Breach Cathedral and the Breach Tarot
blurb: A series of plotter drawings: slab architecture interrupted by a living helix, then all twenty-two Major Arcana in the same language, with a pocket deck for print.

name: InkSight
blurb: Reads a plotter SVG entirely in the browser and reports what is in it: pen count, path lengths, travel, bounds, and the things that break a plot. Made for agents, readable by people.

name: Lemon Agent
tagline: Guides for working with coding agents
blurb: Free course and field guides for safe coding-agent workflows: a seven-lesson starting course, three deeper field guides, and two numbered failure lists installable as agent skills.

name: lookout
tagline: OTEL trace collector for AI agents
blurb: OpenTelemetry collector purpose-built for agent workflows. Ingests gRPC/HTTP traces, enriches spans with token-cost calculations and anomaly detection, groups by session, exposes a web UI, REST API, MCP server, and TUI.

name: skiff
blurb: A single-binary, single-YAML control plane between docker-compose and Kubernetes. Health-aware lifecycle management, scheduling, service discovery, and a unified API for containers, native daemons, and scheduled jobs on one machine.

name: nanoclaw
tagline: A small assistant that runs in containers
blurb: A lightweight agent framework that runs in containers for isolation. Connects to Telegram, Slack, Discord, Gmail and other messaging apps, keeps memory, and runs scheduled jobs.

name: bosun
blurb: The entrypoint agents come in through, and the thing that decides when they start, stop, and hand off.

name: hoist
tagline: Git worktree manager for parallel agents
blurb: Keeps several agents working in one repo without fighting over a single checkout. A worktree each, cleaned up when the work lands.

name: gangway
tagline: Docker API shim for Apple containers
blurb: Translates the Docker Engine API to the Apple container CLI, so tools that only speak Docker keep working on the native runtime.

name: feltmath
blurb: A blackjack and hold'em practice app: configurable American rules, live odds and EV, a basic-strategy coach, and AI table mates. Installs as a PWA.

name: Typing Arena
blurb: A typing competition for people sharing one screen, with progression systems and themed content.

name: BrightPath
blurb: Procedural slogan generator, synergy clustering, stakeholder lingo, and Fisher-Yates-shuffled visuals. A deadpan parody of management-consultancy web design rendered with unironic craft.
